Chapter 713 - 713 Dark Universe; Kneel Down!

713 Dark Universe; Kneel Down!

In the Dark Universe, the wind howled and black water filled the air.

The air was filled with the pungent smell of blood, and from time to time, terrifying screams could be heard.

The entire world was like hell, incomparably terrifying.

Lin Chengzhen and Li Hao were here!

However, they were completely different from a year ago.

Their bodies were in tatters, and there were several hideous wounds on their bodies that were so deep that their bones could be seen.

There was a long golden rope around their waists that kept twisting like a dragon’s tendon.

Their bodies emitted a terrifying baleful aura.

“What the hell is this place?” Li Hao muttered.

“My dad just contacted me,” Lin Chengzhen said.

“Your dad?” Li Hao was surprised. “He’s here too?”

As he spoke, he kept looking around, but he did not find anything.

“It’s my father’s special ability. He can ignore space and distance and communicate with anyone.” Lin Chengzhen shook his head.

“F*ck! Is your father that powerful?” Li Hao shouted.

“My father is indeed very powerful,” Lin Chengzhen said. “I heard that he once went to the universe beyond Earth. My mother said that my father is the strongest person.”

Li Haoyan’s eyes widened in disbelief.

“He’s been to the universe! F*ck! Is your father a god? The Jade Emperor?”

Many characters from myths and legends immediately appeared in his mind.

“By the way, did your father give you that pearl?” Li Hao said.

“My father gave me the pearl, but he’s not the Jade Emperor,” Lin Chengzhen said.

“Then did you tell your father about our situation?” Li Hao asked. “Will we be saved soon?”

Before entering the mystic realm, he had always wanted to become stronger.

For this, no matter how great the price, no matter how hard it was, he would not hesitate.

However, in the past half a year, he had become a little afraid.

This place was simply too dangerous and terrifying.

Despair…

“I didn’t tell my dad.” Lin Chengzhen shook his head. “Although he is very powerful, you also know the situation in this world. There’s also that terrifying Moses… I don’t want Dad to take the risk.”

“Also, don’t you think this place is really suitable for cultivation?” Lin Chengzhen asked after a pause. “In such a short period of time, our cultivation has increased so much. If we continue, we will definitely become stronger!”

Li Hao’s gaze also became firm as he said, “Then let’s continue adventuring!”

At this moment, countless ripples suddenly appeared in the endless black water, and a pungent smell pervaded the air. One by one, spiders with human faces bared their fangs and brandished their claws as they popped their heads out.

“More monsters are coming out!” Li Hao shouted. “Be careful!”

…

Earth, Coiling Dragon Villa.

“Have you found Cheng Zhen?” Hu Tian asked anxiously.

Lin Fan nodded his head. “Found him. He entered a very mysterious secret realm and is currently in seclusion. We don’t have to worry.”

When Hu Tian heard this, she heaved a sigh of relief and said, “I see.”

She hugged Lin Fan gently. After a moment of warmth, she slowly left.

Meanwhile, Lin Fan focused his attention on the system.

“May I know where Lin Chengzhen is?”

[This requires 100,000 spirit stones. Do you wish to inquire?]

“Yes!”

[Dark Universe. A universe that’s hidden in the endless darkness.]

“Can I enter the Dark Universe?”

[Yes, with the host’s current strength, it will take 10,000 years.]

Lin Fan frowned.

10,000 years…

One had to know that even if one counted the thousand years of slumber, Lin Fan had only lived for a little over 1,000 years.

10,000 years was indeed a long time.

If he rushed over and then rushed back, what would happent o Earth and his family?

Furthermore, Lin Fan did not know if he could find Lin Chengzhen and bring him back.

Lin Fan sighed and said, “I have to be stronger.”

At this moment, a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! It’s been 60 years since you’ve obtained the advanced system. You’re rewarded with True Flame Stone, Immortal Crystal x1, Transcendence Golden Body x1.]

[True Flame Stone: A stone with rich fire energy. After absorbing it, you can quickly increase your fire energy.]

Lin Fan set up a formation around the area and started to absorb the True Flame Stone.

After a while, the entire space was completely enveloped by the scorching flames.

As for Lin Fan himself, he seemed to have transformed into a gigantic fire dragon as he roared out maniacally with an aura that shook the heavens.

If not for the protection of the array formation, the surrounding tens of thousands of kilometers… In fact, the entire Earth might have turned into a fireball in an instant.

After a long while, Lin Fan heaved a sigh of relief.

The surrounding flames suddenly stopped.

At the same time, a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, your Fire Laws has advanced to Advanced.]

Advanced!

This was the first advanced law that Lin Fan had grasped.

He slowly raised his hand, and his entire arm and even his entire body turned into a ball of flames. He possessed a tyrannical power that could melt and devour everything.

Lin Fan said, “This feeling is really amazing. I wonder how far I can walk on the fire path in the River of Time.”

He left just like that.

Lin Fan willed it and entered the River of Time.

He took a step forward and walked on the fire path, continuing to move forward.

100 meters.

200 meters.

500 meters.

1,000 meters.

2,000 meters.

5,000 meters!

Lin Fan finally felt a little strained.

However, he continued to move forward.

At this moment, a strange voice suddenly sounded behind him.

“Hmm?”

Then, a man in fiery red armor appeared beside him.

It was Zhu Yan.

“It’s you, little fellow,” Zhu Yan said in surprise.

The first time Zhu Yan met Lin Fan, he realized that he was cultivating many laws at the same time and had a bad impression of him. He felt that Lin Fan was too greedy and would never achieve anything.

Now that he saw Lin Fan walking so far down the path of fire, it was inevitable that he would be shocked.

One had to know…

It had only been a few decades since the first time he had met Lin Fan.

In just a few decades, he had made such great progress!

Monster!

[Ding! Zhu Yan has developed hatred toward you due to your extraordinary talent in Fire Laws. His hatred has increased to three stars.]

When Lin Fan heard this, he frowned.

“Little fellow, you’re not bad. Kneel down and be my disciple.”

He raised his head and maintained a superior attitude.

It was as if letting Lin Fan become his disciple was a great blessing.

Regarding this…

Lin Fan said calmly, “I never said I wanted to be your disciple.”
